references.text: The children of Israel cried out to the Lord when they were in distress by the Red Sea, the same pattern of crying out to God in desperation
The children of Israel cried out to the Lord under Cushan's oppression, and the Lord raised up a deliverer
The children of Israel cried out to the Lord under Eglon's oppression, the same cycle of cries for help and deliverance
Israel was oppressed by the Midianites and cried out to the Lord, the same pattern of oppression and calls for help
The children of Israel cried out to the Lord and confessed their sin under the oppression of the Philistines and Ammonites
Samuel reminded the people that their fathers cried out to the Lord when they were in distress, and the Lord sent deliverance
Pharaoh's chariots are mentioned as a threat against Israel, parallel to Sisera's iron chariots
Joshua warned about iron chariots among the Canaanites, the same challenge that Israel faced under Sisera
The psalmist describes how people cry out to the Lord in their distress, and He delivers them from their troubles
